import datetime
import math
import re
import polars as pl

NULL_VALUES = ["", "N/A", "n/a", "-", "null", "NULL"]

def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    # Helper for replacing text placeholders with nulls
    def clean_str(col: pl.Expr) -> pl.Expr:
        return pl.when(col.is_in(NULL_VALUES)).then(None).otherwise(col)

    # 1. contact_id: uppercase string
    contact_id = clean_str(pl.col("Record ID")).str.to_uppercase()

    # 2. full_name: text string
    full_name = clean_str(pl.col("Name"))

    # 3. email: lowercase string
    email = clean_str(pl.col("E-mail")).str.to_lowercase()

    # 4. phone: E.164 format with default NZ country code (+64)
    # Extract digits from mobile, e.g., "(09) 450 9443" -> "094509443" -> remove leading 0 -> "+6494509443"
    mobile_clean = clean_str(pl.col("Mobile"))
    digits = mobile_clean.str.replace_all(r"\D", "")
    phone = (
        pl.when(digits.is_not_null() & (digits != ""))
        .then(
            pl.concat_str([
                pl.lit("+64"),
                digits.str.strip_prefix("0")
            ])
        )
        .otherwise(None)
    )

    # 5. company: organisation string
    company = clean_str(pl.col("Organisation"))

    # 6. created_on: date parsed using format "%d-%b-%Y"
    created_on = clean_str(pl.col("Date Created")).str.to_date(format="%d-%b-%Y", strict=False)

    # 7. lifetime_value: money parsed to Float64 rounded to 2 places
    spend_clean = (
        clean_str(pl.col("Total Spend"))
        .str.replace_all(r"[$]", "")
        .str.replace_all(r",", "")
    )
    lifetime_value = spend_clean.cast(pl.Float64, strict=False).round(2)

    return raw.select([
        contact_id.alias("contact_id"),
        full_name.alias("full_name"),
        email.alias("email"),
        phone.alias("phone"),
        company.alias("company"),
        created_on.alias("created_on"),
        lifetime_value.alias("lifetime_value"),
    ])
